goals.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Zusammenspiel von Zellteilung, Differenzierung und Morphogenese bei Tieren beschreiben.
goals.descriptionEn: The learner can describe the interplay of cell division, differentiation, and morphogenesis in animals.
goals.rationale: KEEP: one animal developmental process connects additional cells, differentiated functions and tissue form; the supplied intervention case separates their contributions without demanding a separate species-life-cycle catalogue.

goals.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Zellteilung, Differenzierung und Morphogenese bei Pflanzen erläutern.
goals.descriptionEn: The learner can explain cell division, differentiation, and morphogenesis in plants.
goals.rationale: KEEP: one plant developmental process connects division, differentiated functions and organ form. New leaf/fruit cases provide bounded independent transfer; NI5/6 and SL5 remain partial context rather than complete cell-level source witnesses.

goals.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Rolle von Meristemen und zellulären Signalsystemen erklären.
goals.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the role of meristems and cellular signaling systems.
goals.rationale: KEEP pending independent atomicity judgement: meristem cell supply and given cell-to-cell growth regulation are assessed through the same local growth process; both official E.5 bullets remain present. The profile never reduces general signaling to one universal hormone.

goals.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Diffusion, Osmose und Plasmolyse experimentell untersuchen und Ergebnisse deuten.
goals.descriptionEn: The learner can experimentally investigate diffusion, osmosis, and plasmolysis and interpret the results.
goals.rationale: KEEP pending independent atomicity judgement: one inquiry family investigating diffusion, osmosis and its visible plant-cell consequence. All three source components and actual performance remain required; an interpretation-only dataset cannot close the performance expectation.

goals.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann unterschiedliche Membranmodelle darstellen und deren Aussagekraft kritisch prüfen.
goals.descriptionEn: The learner can depict different membrane models and critically examine their validity.
goals.rationale: KEEP: depicting and testing two structural models against given observations is one model-comparison competence. Modern appearance alone does not validate a model; the full source bullet still includes biomembrane schema beyond this target.

goals.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann den Einfluss der Temperatur auf Enzymaktivität mithilfe der RGT-Regel quantifizieren.
goals.descriptionEn: The learner can quantify the influence of temperature on enzyme activity using the RGT rule.
goals.rationale: KEEP: quantifying the temperature component from a supplied factor and checking its valid range is one bounded calculation competence. Q10 not universally 2; no denaturation extrapolation. Existing temperature-activity prerequisite and memory rule/card remain required.

goals.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann allosterische und nicht-kompetitive Hemmung an Beispielen erklären und auf Alltagsbezüge übertragen.
goals.descriptionEn: The learner can explain allosteric and non-competitive inhibition using examples and apply them to everyday contexts.
goals.rationale: KEEP: one mechanism/data-based inhibition explanation plus contextual transfer. No equivalence of allostery with pure noncompetitive kinetics is asserted. The existing competition prerequisite remains; the allosteric PNG is explicitly not a kinetic proof.

HEThemeCompulsoryBoundaries.E.4-E.5: not listed among compulsory themes; current optional authored target universe remains unchanged
